title: Reduced APN permutations and a disproof of the Galois-ring lifting conjecture
summary: We construct infinite families of reduced almost perfect nonlinear (APN) permutations of $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$ that admit coefficientwise permutation lifts to $\mathrm{GR}(2^k,m)$ for every $k>1$. These families disprove Conjecture~2 of Rønjom and Sandrib (Cryptogr. Commun., 2026), even for reduced polynomial representatives. For every odd $m\ge5$ with $3\nmid m$, we obtain explicit seven-term polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with formal derivative identically one.
